description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Online' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Tool' namespace. The class provides a method to add online customer tracking by inserting data into the database.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: A model class for tracking online customer activity within the OpenCart catalog system.

methods.name: addOnline
methods.description: Adds an online record for a customer identified by their IP, customer ID, accessed URL, and referer. Cleans up old entries based on expiration hours.
